passage:
The sign outside the old bookstore lost one letter. It should have said "BOOKS," but now it said "BOOS."
Children laughed whenever they passed by. The owner planned to fix it, but before he did, Halloween came.
A student suggested keeping the broken sign for one week and making a ghost book display. The owner agreed. He placed mystery stories and scary books near the window.
The display became popular. More people entered the store than usual.
After Halloween, the owner fixed the sign. But he kept the fallen letter on the counter as a reminder.
Sometimes a mistake can become an idea if people are willing to look at it differently.
